prompt.text: Use case: stylized-concept. Create ONE production game-art atlas for ZONE, a gritty urban crime browser RPG. This is a single coherent sheet, precisely 4 columns and 2 rows of EQUAL rectangular panels, no gaps, no borders, no words, no typography, no logos, no UI. Each panel is a detailed cinematic painted environment illustration with realistic architectural proportions and visible tactile materials, muted charcoal, warm amber dusk, steel blue shadows, damp streets, premium crime-game editorial art. Central subject entirely fits within each panel and is recognizable when displayed in a narrow card. Exact row-major order: top row 1 ramshackle wooden shack with corrugated roof in a rundown city alley; 2 old weathered residential trailer in a yard; 3 modest brick city apartment building; 4 pair of attached suburban houses (semi-detached). Bottom row 1 standalone spacious suburban house; 2 luxurious beachfront villa with pool; 3 private tropical island with one mansion and a dock; 4 atmospheric city waterfront establishing scene. All panels same art direction, lens and dusk atmosphere, premium hand-painted realism, no flat vector shapes, no cartoon toys. Avoid weapons or people, focus on residence. Atlas landscape aspect 2:1 if possible, high detail. No text whatsoever.
